model_c1.pth.name: IMDModel (ELA + CNN)
model_c1.pth.source: Trained by the project author (train.ipynb, checkpoint model_c1_e100_v2); converted from a pickled module by scripts/convert_imd_to_state_dict.py
model_c1.pth.evaluation: Not validated. Kodak splice set AUC 0.619 (0.500-0.728) vs mean-ELA baseline 0.566: fails the validation rule. CASIA v2 test split 0.780, possibly contaminated (trained on CASIA, split unrecorded). The API reports its score as experimental (label UNVALIDATED). See docs/eval.md.

model_c2.pth.name: IMDModel (ELA + CNN), retrained on CASIA v2
model_c2.pth.source: scripts/train_image.py on scripts/prepare_casia.py (JPEG-origin CASIA v2, split by source image, seed 20261108); temperature scaling folded into the last layer
model_c2.pth.evaluation: Not validated, not deployed. CASIA v2 test AUC 0.962 (0.952-0.971) but Kodak splice set AUC 0.576 (0.460-0.685): does not generalise beyond CASIA. See docs/eval.md.
